issues.title: 非递归 WITH CTE
issues.boundary: PASS for local Core parsing and execution of single/multiple non-recursive CTEs in FROM, IN, and correlated EXISTS; CTE output-column lists and WITH RECURSIVE remain unsupported. Remote parity and external issue-thread confirmation pending.

issues.title: UNION ALL/INTERSECT/EXCEPT
issues.boundary: PASS for local Core parsing and execution of UNION ALL, INTERSECT, and EXCEPT with ordered deterministic relation results; operator precedence is left-associative and remote parity/external issue-thread confirmation remain pending.

issues.title: ANSI 窗口函数 OVER
issues.boundary: PASS for local Core parsing/execution of OVER() and OVER (ORDER BY time ASC), row_number(), and existing measurement window functions; PARTITION BY, non-time/descending order, ROWS/RANGE frames, relation/JOIN paths, remote parity and external issue-thread confirmation remain pending.

issues.title: CAST(expr AS type)
issues.boundary: PASS for local Core parsing and literal/column CAST across measurement, relation, document, join, JSON-file, hybrid, and vector-search evaluators; supports INT/FLOAT/BOOL/STRING/DATETIME/BLOB/JSON with NULL propagation. VECTOR/GEOPOINT targets are explicit unsupported boundaries; remote parity and external issue-thread confirmation remain pending.

issues.title: 常用字符串函数
issues.boundary: PASS for local Core string scalar registration and relation SELECT/WHERE execution: trim/ltrim/rtrim, length/char_length, substring/substr, replace, left/right, and ordinal starts_with/ends_with/contains with NULL propagation and bounded integer/string diagnostics. TRIM(... FROM ...), collation-sensitive matching, byte-length semantics, remote parity and external issue-thread confirmation remain pending.

issues.title: date_diff/日期格式化
issues.boundary: PASS for local Core date_diff/datediff and date_format/format_datetime/to_char/strftime scalar functions in relation SELECT/WHERE paths, with DATETIME/DateTimeOffset/Unix milliseconds inputs, bounded date parts and 128-character formats, NULL propagation and deterministic invalid-part/marker diagnostics. Locale-sensitive formatting, timezone database/calendar semantics, remote parity and external issue-thread confirmation remain pending.

issues.title: 聚合 DISTINCT
issues.boundary: PASS for local Core COUNT/SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX(DISTINCT field) parser and measurement/relationship execution, including duplicate elimination, NULL exclusion and COUNT(DISTINCT *) rejection; SqlAggregateDistinctTests passes 4/4. Multi-expression/ordered-set/window DISTINCT, remote parity and external issue-thread confirmation remain pending.

issues.title: BETWEEN/ILIKE
issues.boundary: PASS for local Core BETWEEN/NOT BETWEEN inclusive range predicates and ILIKE/NOT ILIKE invariant pattern matching in relation/measurement filters; SqlBetweenIlikeTests passes 3/3. Range syntax is desugared to existing three-valued comparisons and ILIKE to invariant lower+LIKE; symmetric ranges, locale-specific collations, remote parity and external issue-thread confirmation remain pending.

issues.title: DECIMAL/NUMERIC 精确类型
issues.boundary: PASS for local Core DECIMAL/NUMERIC parsing, exact System.Decimal CAST and arithmetic, relation-table persistence, numeric primary-key range filtering, bounded precision/scale validation, equality-key lookup and schema format v9; SqlDecimalTests passes 5/5 and SqlCastTests passes 9/9. Decimal range planning falls back to scans because text keys are not numeric-sortable. Embedded and remote ADO.NET Columns metadata carries precision/scale when schema includes it. Remote Frame parity, fixed-hardware evidence, overflow/scale enforcement beyond System.Decimal and external issue-thread confirmation remain pending.

issues.title: TIME 类型与仅时间语义
issues.boundary: PASS for local Core TIME parser/CAST, relation-table TimeOnly ticks payload and schema format v10, equality/order comparisons, NULL handling, strict [00:00:00,24:00:00) validation, TimeOnly/TimeSpan parameter binding, and embedded ADO GetSchema/GetFieldType; SqlTimeTests passes 3/3 and the ADO TIME regression passes 1/1. DATETIME/DateTimeOffset-to-TIME conversion is explicitly rejected; cross-day/24:00 semantics, remote typed TIME restoration/Frame parity, fixed-hardware evidence and external issue-thread confirmation remain pending.

issues.title: 整数位运算 &、|
issues.boundary: Local Core lexer/parser and relation SELECT/WHERE/UPDATE semantics pass; remote parity and issue-thread confirmation pending.
